name: tidy
description: Gives the model a tool to compact its own context, suggests compacting at boundaries, and keeps the prompt cache warm while background work runs.

compactNudgeTokens.title: Compaction reminder size
compactNudgeTokens.description: Tidy suggests compacting at a boundary (after recorded work, or as a wait starts) when the context is at least this many tokens. 0 turns suggestions off. Autocompact still handles overflow.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Prompt-cache lifetime in minutes, overriding the one tidy detects. Leave empty to detect it as Claude Code chooses it; set 5 if you usually draw extra usage, which drops the cache to five minutes. Tidy keeps a waiting session's cache warm by reading it just before this lifetime ends. 0 turns keep-alive off.

keepaliveBudget.title: Keep-alive budget
keepaliveBudget.description: Spending cap for keep-alive in one wait, counted in full cache writes: once its cache reads would cost this many writes, tidy lets the cache expire. 0 turns keep-alive off.
